questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Wicketkeeping Dismissals' in the 15/16 season (T20 only)?
questions.explanation: Mieke de Ridder holds it, with a total of 5, a joint record shared with Sinalo Jafta.

questions.question: Dolphins set a database record (15/16 season, List A only) with a value of 228. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Biggest Win by Runs', held by Dolphins.

questions.question: Who has achieved the 50+ runs and 5+ wickets in a match double more times, Cherri Cannon or Jana Nell?
questions.explanation: Cherri Cannon: 1 times. Jana Nell: 2 times.

questions.question: At which ground did Titans record their 'Highest Total' (T20 only)?
questions.explanation: It was at Sinovich Park — highest total of 176, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/02/12.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 only meetings, who has the edge, Dragons or Lions?
Which player is the only one in this database's history to score 200+ runs AND take 3+ wickets in the same match?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade is the sole member of the 200-run/3-wicket club, achieving it in a single match against Kei on 10 February 2018 (212 runs, 3 for 26).
